events.text: random q, why is the super bowl always on a sunday in february? it used to be january right

It moved because the NFL season got longer.
- Through the 2001 season the game was usually in late January.
- The 9/11 postponement pushed the 2002 game into February, and later schedule changes kept it there.
- In 2021 the league went from a 16- to a 17-game regular season, adding a week, which locked it into the second Sunday of February.
- Sunday is the TV choice: the biggest audience of the week, and Monday travel for fans.

6 and a half minutes from a rolling boil, straight from the fridge, then into ice water.

how does curling scoring even work. leo is glued to the olympics and asking me and I have no idea

Only one team scores per end: whoever has the stone closest to the button (centre) gets a point for each of their stones closer than the other team's best stone.
- A stone must be touching the house (the rings) to count.
- A game is usually 10 ends (8 in mixed doubles); most points wins.
- The team that scores throws first next end, so teams with the last-stone advantage (the hammer) sometimes 'blank' an end on purpose to keep it.
- Kid version for Leo: it's like shuffleboard on ice, closest rocks to the bullseye win.

events.text:
Her best path is a formal demand letter, then the contractor's bond, then small claims.

- If neither works, Quebec small claims covers up to $15,000 with no lawyers and a filing fee of about $112-$231.
- The OPC has free template letters.

events.task: Check whether the RBQ security bond covers residential deposits
events.report:
RBQ guarantee (rbq.example/consommateurs):
- Licensed general and specialty contractors must hold a security bond: $40,000 (general) or $20,000 (specialty).
- It covers deposits for work not done, for residential work, if the claim is filed within 1 year of the deposit.
- She needs the contract or quote, proof of payment and the demand letter.
Priya's forwarded quote shows an RBQ licence number, so she likely qualifies.
